statement: The first line holds n; the second holds the row of n integers. Produce the row formed by moving its first value to the end while preserving the order of all other values. Print the resulting n values on one line separated by spaces.

example.why: 6 moves to the end and the remaining order stays 2, 9, 4, 1.

hint: Remember the first value, shift the later values one position left, then write the saved value.
mistake: Overwriting the first value before saving it; the last position then receives the wrong number.
